models.name: KOLIBRI 60 LV-I
models.firmware_note: BEC 10 A continuous, 30 A peak; 5.6 V default, 5 to 9 V

automatable_note: The ESC's own button (marked on the ESC) must be pressed after the power-up tones. The bench has no actuator for it.

manual.action: Press the button on the ESC after the cell-count tones (shrink-tube versions: on the back, near the sensor slot).
manual.action_de: Taster am ESC nach den Zellentönen drücken (Schrumpfschlauch-Versionen: hinten, nahe dem Sensoranschluss).

manual.action: Hands off: wait until the ESC has ended its mode confirmation (tones, LED), then tap DONE.
manual.action_de: Nicht berühren: warten, bis der ESC seine Modusbestätigung beendet hat (Töne, LED), dann ERLEDIGT tippen.

entry.confirm_signal: Ascending three-tone sequence plus cell-count tones; descending three-tone sequence after the button press.
steps: Transmitter on, throttle at motor-off (0 %). Connect the ESC master cable to the receiver throttle channel; receiver on.
Connect the motor. Apply drive power.
The ESC sounds an ascending three-tone sequence and single tones for the detected LiPo cell count (long tone = 4 cells, short tone = 1 cell).
Operator: press the button marked on the ESC.
The ESC sounds a descending three-tone sequence, then the mode series 1, 2, 3 ... one tone more per series.
Move the throttle to full (100 %) after the wanted tone count.

The ESC confirms with an ascending three-tone sequence and repeats the mode as tones. Mode 2: a further stick position may be set. Mode 6: move the stick to reverse (0 %) after the full-throttle confirmation.
Wait for the confirmation (up to about 2 s for mode 4) before disconnecting power; otherwise the ESC locks (9 LED flashes).

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to 100 % when the series of the wanted mode sounds.

skip.description: No skip. Disconnecting power before the confirmation locks the ESC.

scheme.confirm_signal: Ascending three-tone sequence, then the mode as single tones.
scheme.exit: Wait for the confirmation, then disconnect drive power.
scheme.description: Throttle at 0 %, apply power, press the ESC button after the cell-count tones. The ESC counts modes as single tones. Full throttle at the wanted count stores the mode. Modes 8, 9 and 10 continue with a second stage that counts protocol or voltage steps.

Item number 2 is an index chosen here.
Input voltage range, cell count and rated current of each KOLIBRI model are not given in the manual text read.
Mode 5 is listed as unused. Whether the ESC sounds a series for mode 5 is not stated.
Telemetry stage: the number of tones is the protocol number; the time allowed to return the throttle to 0 % is not stated.
BEC stage: tones per 0.2 V step beginning at 5.0 V (no tone) up to 9 V; the value list is derived from that rule.
notes: Telemetry table differs from the KOSMIK: tone 3 is Futaba here and 'not used' on the KOSMIK, and tone 8 (FrSky) exists here only.
INDEX.csv says 'ProgCard II / app'; the German manual mentions the programming unit ProgUNIT 9311 and a Bluetooth module.

The manual asks for the power to stay on until the ESC has confirmed the mode: a supply off before that is taken as programming broken off and locks the ESC, shown as 9 LED flashes (Kontronik_KOLIBRI_de.pdf p.7, p.9, p.10 (DE)). The step before_power_off holds the run powered until the operator taps DONE.
